top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The sign in and out log was not maintained.     Corrected at Inspection: The times and initials were placed for those who had not been sign in.

top_violation_types.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: On the infant/toddler playground they is only one exit, the fence area needs another exit.
